look_here_first: Low fine-textured woodland sedge with narrow V-shaped leaves and small separate spikes, especially common on calcareous soils beneath juniper and oak.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays County is present in the repaired Master Plant Pool and the user has two wild iNaturalist observations.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for learning now; native metrics excluded until later county reconciliation.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Carex sedges have sheathing leaves and perigynia enclosing the fruits.
best_field_traits: young blades V-shaped in cross section
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Lower and finer-textured than C. edwardsiana; much smaller and drier-site than C. emoryi or C. crus-corvi.
